enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Dexterity +7: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +7 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Melee Alacrity 10%: Gain 10% Enhancement bonus to Melee attack speed. Does not stack with the Haste spell.
Hide +15: Passive: +15 Competence bonus to the Hide skill.
Woodsman's Guile: When all three items from the set are equipped, you will gain a +4 bonus to your To-Hit and +6 bonus to your Damage on any attack that would be considered a Sneak Attack.
